mutations.name: one transient sample of an error kind gates as a held error
kills: a finding in one mid-beat sample is info, not an error (an entrance fade passing through)
samples in neighbouring beats do not make one finding held
the same text on two twin elements in neighbouring samples does not hold (two rail arrows, each mid-fade)
two samples that are not neighbours do not hold

mutations.name: a finding seen in one sample counts as held across samples
kills: a finding in one mid-beat sample is info, not an error (an entrance fade passing through)
a single sample at the settled end moment is an error
samples in neighbouring beats do not make one finding held
the same text on two twin elements in neighbouring samples does not hold (two rail arrows, each mid-fade)
two samples that are not neighbours do not hold

mutations.name: classify gates every known kind whatever gate list the caller passes
kills: a kind left out of the gate list stays info however long it holds

mutations.name: the start and enter moments read every kind, not only the frame kinds
kills: the start and enter moments read only the frame kinds; an entrance mid-fade there is not a finding
